title: All Regional Directors/Joint Directors (I/c)
content:
P-14011/2/2026-BFT-II I/4206853/2026

F.No. P-14011/2/2026-BFT-II Date: 04-08-2026

To

All Regional Directors/Joint Directors (I/c)
Employees’ State Insurance Corporation

Subject: Implementation of New Insured Person (IP) Registration
functionality in ERP – reg.

Sir/Madam,

I am directed to inform that a new Insured Person (IP)
Registration functionality has been developed in the ERP system for
registration of employees under the Employees' State Insurance
Scheme.

The module has been designed to facilitate seamless registration of
Insured Persons, capture of requisite details and generation of Insurance
Number. The module shall be used by the employer for processing and
facilitating registration-related activities.

Further, the employees themselves may complete the authentication
process through the ESIC Health Connect App, thereby enabling a
simplified and user-friendly registration process.

A User Manual containing detailed workﬂow, operating instructions,
screenshots, and step-by-step guidance for the new IP Registration
functionality is enclosed for information, training, and necessary action.

All Regional Offices/Sub-Regional Offices are requested to:

i. Disseminate the enclosed User Manual among all concerned
oﬃcers/oﬃcials, Branch Oﬃces, and stakeholders under their
jurisdiction.

ii. Organise suitable orientation/training sessions for ﬁeld
functionaries to ensure smooth implementation of the new
functionality.

iii. Facilitate employers and Insured Persons in understanding and
utilising the new registration process.

The contents of this communication may be brought to the notice of
all concerned for information and necessary action.
